policy.method: Preregister all twelve prompts and thirty-six case/seed pairs. Freeze before baseline generation or any new tuning. Inspect both base conditions at all seeds. Later compare both adapter conditions at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 against the matched base controls; record all failures and uncertainty without ranking by loss or pixel differences. Legacy cases are exposed diagnostics. New holdouts are excluded from training captions, data selection and hyperparameter tuning; baseline inspection is declared exposure, not a claim of a hidden test set. Use only diagnostic regressions for C-04 development. If a holdout informs tuning, declare contamination in a new additive corpus and add fresh holdouts while preserving every old case and seed.
policy.limitations: Twelve hand-authored prompts are broader targeted SDXL still-life coverage, not statistical population coverage. Exact normalized caption exclusion cannot prove semantic or pretraining independence. Counts/material/layout require direct inspection with uncertain allowed. Strength and no-trigger expectations are frozen now but base-only results cannot measure adapter behavior. ComfyUI dpmpp_2m/karras, CFG 7, 20 steps, 512px differs from the retained Diffusers diagnostics; same seeds do not establish sampler parity.
